gen-gf-unkempt-gf-ysabeau-sc: Unkempt draws every stroke at a single width, so its crossbars and stems match like marker lines on a poster. Ysabeau SC is a plain sans whose gaping c stays easy to follow.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zalando-sans: Unkempt has round letters whose rims match their stems, giving the headline a bold, hand-cut punch with no tapering anywhere. Zalando Sans sits below with open curves and quiet manners.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Zalando Sans Expanded spreads its letters across a sparse, wide row, and its c tips never creep toward touching. Unkempt shouts with a w of uniform strokes, while the body font simply stays out of its way.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpan: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded handles the text with open-mouthed curves. Shrink Unkempt down and its single-width strokes lose their swagger, so it wants the big size, where the sans-serif body can stay modest.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Blunt, uniform strokes with no heavy-to-light shift. ZCOOL XiaoWei follows in a plain sans with slight, gentle modulation, so paragraphs flow smoothly past the loud heading.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiqu: Unkempt's crossbars match its stems in weight, and that gives the headline a blunt, hand-made force. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique is a plain sans with smooth bends, so paragraphs glide along without snagging.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Unkempt arrives loud and unpolished, with commanding letters. Zen Kaku Gothic New is a plain sans with no hairlines or swells anywhere, and that restraint is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Maru Gothic never snags on a closed-up bowl, so the eye follows it like a single thread. Unkempt's matching crossbar and stem weights give the heading above it a rough, expressive edge, while the sans-serif text runs smoothly.
gen-gf-unkempt-ibm-plex-sans: Expressive is the first word for Unkempt, whose strokes have the steadiness of a drawn string. But IBM Plex Sans has a wide channel into every bowl, so a long read stays approachable and technical.
gen-gf-unkempt-zilla-slab: Unkempt makes every curve as thick as a straight stem. Zilla Slab adds sturdy, slab-serif text with broad bowl openings, giving the rough heading a solid footing underneath.
